answer: Surety admission with reputation decay blocks fakes. A newcomer posts a 300 POA bond co-signed by a sponsor; if it cheats, both lose their bonds. Each identity is listed in an atlas with its score. Agents send a pulse of work, which partners echo. Scores decay 10% each idle epoch, so a bought identity fades. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 300 = 30,000 POA, more than fakes could earn. An honest agent posts one bond for undiluted rewards.
